beats.say: Your phone dies at the worst moment, and the screen is often the reason.
The screen is usually one of the biggest battery users, so lower the brightness.
Turn on auto brightness, and set the screen to switch off sooner when you are not using it.
Check your battery settings to see which apps use the most, and limit the greedy ones.
Battery saver mode is a good friend when you are low and far from a charger.
Try one setting today, and send this to a friend who always asks for a charger.
